{{Quote|To the north lies a deep-cut canyon. At the end of it you will find ruins: all that is left of dark Kabus-Dabeh. They are the remannts of an ancient and evil people. You must go there. One of our bravest protectors has placed a ''skuhm''-hid bag of metal coins somewhere in the ruin. You must find this bag and return it here. If you persevere, you will prove your worth. If you do not, we will not regard you as an honorable negotiator.|Chief Muza clansman|<ref name="RoKD ">{{WEGCite|story=Ruins of Kabus-Dabeh|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>}}
A '''bravest protector''' was a member of the [[Muza]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was revered by his fellows.<ref name="RoKD " /> At some point by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> one of the bravest protectors hid a ''[[skuhm]]''-[[Leather/Legends|leather]] bag in the ruins of [[Kabus-Dabeh]]. Whoever retrieved the bag, the Muza believed, must be respected.<ref name="RoKD " />
